userStories.title: Grouped navigation and the phone More sheet

One flag per item (e.g. `ready: boolean`) hides an item whose page isn't built: Board, Playbooks and Analytics are hidden in this wave
Desktop sidebar shows the group labels (small caps label style from the style page) and keeps the existing counts
Phone: tabs Chats · Missions · Shelf · More; More opens a sheet (dialog with focus trap, Escape closes, focus returns) listing the remaining ready pages and Look
phoneChrome() covers the new routes (lists get the tab bar; detail pages bring their own back link)
Tests: grouping and order, hidden items not rendered, the More sheet opens, lists items, closes on Escape and returns focus
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: components/shell/nav.ts: NAV_GROUPS (every page, `ready` flag; Board/Playbooks/Analytics false), visibleGroups(), NAV_ITEMS (ready, flat), PHONE_TABS (Chats/Missions/Shelf), MORE_ITEMS (Agents, Knowledge, Look), isMoreActive; phoneChrome gives the tab bar to every nav href except / (wave 4 lists included), detail pages none. userStories.title: Page patterns, usePoll and StateChip
userStories.description: As a developer, I want three shared page patterns and a gentle polling hook so every page is consistent and kind to the backend.
acceptanceCriteria: components/page/GridPage.tsx: title, optional count, filter chips, optional search box, children grid/list, Load more, and the loading, empty (with optional mascot slot) and error (with Try again) states. Built from existing tokens and components
components/page/DetailPage.tsx: back link, header (title, chips, actions), main column and side panel, collapsing to one column on phones
components/page/LiveRunPage.tsx: header with StateChip and an actions slot, progress bar, steps slot, activity feed slot, mascot slot (with caption), side panel slot
components/page/StateChip.tsx: glyph + word for each tone (running ●, needs-you ◆, done ✓, failed ✕, paused ‖, queued ○, idle —); colour from Look variables; never colour alone

hooks/usePoll.ts: usePoll(fn, intervalMs, { visibleOnly = true, stopWhen?, immediate = true }); pauses while document.visibilityState is hidden, resumes on visible, stops when stopWhen(result) is true, never overlaps calls, cleans up on unmount

lib/poll/intervals.ts: the only place poll intervals are defined: MISSION_DETAIL 10000, FLEET 10000, LIST 30000, DOCUMENT_PROCESSING 7000, PLAYBOOK_RUN 10000. A test fails if any interval is below the skill's minimum (10 s detail/fleet, 30 s lists, 5 s document processing)
Tests: usePoll pauses when hidden and resumes, stops on stopWhen, never overlaps; each pattern renders its states; StateChip renders glyph and word
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: components/page/: GridPage (status: loading|failed|empty{message,action,mascot}|ready; filters/search/loadMore/actions props), DetailPage (back, title, chips, actions, children, side+sideLabel), LiveRunPage (back?, state: StateChipProps, actions, progress{value,max,label}, steps, activity, mascot+mascotCaption, side), StateChip (tone + optional label), parts.tsx (FilterChips, SearchBox, BackLink, PageLoading, PageFailed), all wrap PageColumns and share page.module.css. hooks/usePoll.ts returns {state: loading|failed{error}|ready{value,stale,stopped}, refresh()}; pass a memoised fn, call it with a POLL_INTERVALS value (tests/poll/intervals.test.ts fails a usePoll caller that doesn't import the table). Engine in lib/poll/poller.ts.

userStories.title: Missions routes and client
userStories.description: As a developer, I want every Missions call available through the safe proxy.
acceptanceCriteria: Proxy routes per skills/.../references/missions.md using the existing forwardToBackend with per-route query allowlists: GET/POST /api/missions (list: state, limit, offset), GET /api/missions/stats (period), GET /api/missions/[id], GET /api/missions/[id]/events (event_type, limit, offset), GET /api/missions/[id]/cost, PATCH /api/missions/[id]/plan, POST /api/missions/[id]/{approve,reject,pause,resume,cancel,replan}, DELETE /api/missions/[id]

Also GET /api/agents → backend /api/agents/ (allowlist: include_workspace_system, limit, skip, status, search) and lib/agents/names.ts with a pure agentNameMap(agents) — the Mission run page (P-005) needs agent names; P-007 adds the rest of the agent routes
Every route keeps the existing proxy safety (Host, Sec-Fetch-Site, JSON-only bodies, nosniff/CSP headers, pathId validation)
lib/client/api.ts gains typed mission methods; lib/missions/types.ts types the Mission, Task, Event, Stats and Cost shapes from the reference

lib/missions/states.ts: pure helpers: stateTone(state) for StateChip, actionsFor(state) returning the allowed actions from the reference's table, isEnded(state), and taskEnded(taskState) where 'completed' is NOT ended
A 409 maps to a friendly sentence naming the state (e.g. "This Mission is already running, so it can't be approved.")
Tests: allowlists drop unknown keys, actionsFor for every state, taskEnded('completed') is false, 409 message
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Routes app/api/missions/** (id routes via lib/server/missions.ts forwardMission) + app/api/agents -> /api/agents/. Client: api.listMissions/missionStats/getMission/missionEvents/missionCost/createMission and editMissionPlan/approve/reject/pause/resume/cancel/replan/deleteMission (resolve void: refresh after), api.listAgents (Auto included). userStories.title: Knowledge routes: safe upload and download
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the document routes, including the two that aren't plain JSON, done safely.
acceptanceCriteria: JSON routes per references/knowledge.md: GET /api/documents (allowlisted params), GET /api/documents/[id], GET /api/documents/[id]/content, GET /api/documents/[id]/delete-impact, DELETE /api/documents/[id], POST /api/documents/search ({query} required, 422 passed through), GET /api/documents/queue-status → /api/documents/queue/status

Upload POST /api/documents/upload: refuses without header X-Play-Upload: 1, keeps the Host and Sec-Fetch-Site checks, refuses content-length over 50 MB before reading, streams the raw body to the backend with the original content-type (boundary intact) and duplex:'half', never parses the form, long timeout (5 min)

Download GET /api/documents/[id]/download: the server asks the backend for mode=url; an absolute https: URL gets a 302 to it; anything else is fetched server-side and streamed with nosniff and the sandbox CSP; the browser never supplies a path
Never POST /reprocess anywhere (a test greps lib/ and app/ for 'reprocess' and fails if found outside comments)
Tests: upload refused without the header, refused over 50 MB, body bytes forwarded unchanged with the boundary, download https → 302, download other → streamed with safety headers
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

While anything is processing, poll GET /api/documents/[id] with usePoll(DOCUMENT_PROCESSING), stop when processed or failed; 'completed' from the queue counts as processed

app/knowledge/[id]/page.tsx on DetailPage: content rendered as text (markdown through the existing safe Markdown component), Download, Delete with the delete-impact counts shown in the in-page confirmation

Component tests: type and size rejection, upload sends the header, processing poll stops on processed, search results replace the list, delete shows impact before confirming
